latest_features: InventoryActionBurst rewritten with three Nukkit-targeted modes: MismatchFlood, ForceFailNormal, DropFlood
MismatchFlood sends TYPE_MISMATCH packets forcing a full server inventory resync per packet
ForceFailNormal sends TYPE_NORMAL with inverted fromItem values to exhaust server matchItems() validation
DropFlood uses WorldInteraction source to trigger DropItemAction entity spawns on the server per action
